title: Stress-Dependent Assignment Stability in Aerial Tiny-Object Detection
description: Code and derived audit data supporting the manuscript 'Stress-Dependent Assignment Stability in Aerial Tiny-Object Detection'. Version 3.4.0 adds the revision analyses under revision/: derived inputs, scripts and archived outputs for the results added in the first revision, with a runner that recomputes their estimates and bootstrap intervals without a GPU or the benchmark images.
notes: Archive of GitHub release v3.4.0. All-versions concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22478276.
